verdict.rationale: A direct probe found a live llms.txt at docs.coderabbit.ai (HTTP 200) indexing doc pages as .md links. Many cited doc pages are served as clean markdown (.md URLs), and an OpenAPI spec is also published, so an agent can be pointed straight at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation describing or promoting the llms.txt/agent-docs feature, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or a hands-on report of an agent actually consuming these docs.
